terms.gloss: enmity, hostility; usually in the plural, inimīcitiae
evidence: Cic. Tusc. 4.21: inimīcitia īra ulcīscendī tempus observāns (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: In amōre haec omnia īnsunt vitia: injūriae, suspīciōnēs, inimīcitiae, indūtiae, bellum, pāx rūrsum.
phrases.english: In love there are all these faults: wrongs, suspicions, quarrels, truces, war, then peace again.
enmity is anger watching for its time to take revenge
